recipe.name: Caramel Apple Butter Matcha Latte
directions:
In a mug, whisk the matcha powder with the hot water until smooth. Stir in the syrup and add the steamed milk. Garnish.
Caramel Apple Butter SyrupAdd the butters to a saucepan over medium heat. Once melted follow with caramel sauce and vanilla extract. Stir to combine and add the rest of the ingredients. Stir until clump-free. Will keep in the refrigerator for 2 weeks.
